limitations: The first broad candidate selection included four worker runtime cases that correctly failed because the exact archive sandbox has no .git metadata; the corrected selection excluded only those cases, and the same four passed in the clean checkout.

The first Trivy attempt timed out while analyzing a generated Python bytecode cache after testing; the candidate-boundary cleanup/regeneration removed generated artifacts, and the clean source-only retry exited 0. The timeout is retained as a limitation, not hidden.
The exact candidate sandbox has no .git metadata by design, so Git-dependent tests and repository status checks are not claimed from it; main checkout ledger/status checks run separately.
No hosted workflow or GitHub Actions evidence was used.
